about: Modwerk source-only main-rms package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/main-rms.

mods.title: Main RMS
mods.summary: On the compressor pages, the VOL label draws inverted while the main output is louder than -18 dBFS RMS, for gain staging.
mods.description: Main RMS lights the VOL knob's label on the compressor pages while the main output is louder than -18 dBFS RMS. The level is the louder of MAIN L and R, each a mean square averaged over about 300 ms; the label turns on above the threshold and off again 1 dB below it. MAIN is read each audio block from the pair USB and the sampler record, after the compressor. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0009-main-rms, with his code unchanged.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: with the main output above the threshold the VOL label inverted, and it cleared once the output got quieter or after STOP, in builds R8T2 and C3A4 beside other rytm2_mods ports, SXH4 beside the other five Modwerk submissions and MRH4 alone. All four used core-ar2 0.3 or earlier. This package's own bytes have not been flashed from the site.
